theme.title: Why the winter mountain theme?
paragraphs: This site's theme comes from my fond memories of traveling and hiking in the Zakopane mountains in winter while on exchange.
That kind of peace and quiet is hard to come by in Singapore. I want to preserve that positive memory every time I visit this site.
Hello there. You can call me Shun.
I am a Singapore-based security and software engineer. I have a strong interest in cybersecurity, software development, and technology in general.
I am currently still pursuing my undergraduate studies in Computer Science at the National University of Singapore (NUS).
I enjoy playing in CTFs, building software, and working out.
